format.unknown_null_missing: empty cell; never filled with zero
format.steps: integer counts as recorded; zero retained only when actually present
format.phase: reported phase only; empty if absent from frozen evidence

actual_runs.csv.seed_note: The frozen runs array has no seed field; seed cells remain empty. No external config inference.

policy_attempts.csv.outcome_source: environment_final_result, task_success/termination fall back to attempt only when absent
policy_attempts.csv.phase_note: No phase synthesized from planner/action count.

scope.preview: policy_id preview; no full loading qualification
scope.diagnostic: all explicit non-loading task types in this report; this is an analytical scope label

status.actual_runs: Derived only from literal task_success true/false/null: task_success_true/task_success_false/task_success_unknown. Not process exit status.
status.policy_attempts: qualified_integration if qualified_integration true; else unqualified_integration if integration_complete true; else integration_incomplete if integration_complete false; unknown empty. This is integration scope, not task performance.

units.wall_seconds: wall-clock seconds; policy rows use complete attempt wall_time_s
units.maximum_relative_position_drift_m: metres; vessel bottom-frame origin in hand coordinates, includes rotation lever arm

qualification_notes: Diagnostic/preview success does not count toward full-loading success BC, full-loading failure quota, or 20+20 collection.
preinsert_diagnostic success means safe approach/up-motion/declared hold, not insertion, gripper opening or actual loading retreat.

The three qualified policy chains each executed five bounded actions, 15 control ticks (0.25 seconds of actions). Reset render-fence time produces approximately 0.266667 recorded simulated seconds. These are finite integration checks, not task-level evaluation or success rates.
Astra01 has zero executed actions and no valid transition; Astra02 has actual actions but an unqualified observation boundary. Both remain included.
full_success blank represents null/unknown/not applicable and must not be converted to false or true.
record_valid is record/time/action/result integrity within declared scope, not physical calibration or loading success.
All 24 runs and all five policy attempts from the frozen report evidence are exported; selected_primary_evidence does not filter rows.
